verdict.rationale: Forter is a fraud-prevention SaaS platform, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis. First-party docs describe an official Forter MCP that lets AI systems take real actions such as reviewing decisions, managing disputes and updating policies through natural language (forter-docs-9). A getting-started guide covers connecting it to Claude Desktop (forter-docs-20), and a probe confirms the documented MCP page exists (forter-probe-2). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
